agent_explanation: Emergency preemption on W at t=66 immediately forces EW green while NS was still in yellow (step 65) and then green before that, skipping the required 4s all-red clearance and truncating yellow to 1s. The controller does not insert yellow+all-red when emergency becomes active; it jumps directly to the emergency direction green, violating all_red_clearance (0s instead of 4s) and also yellow_duration.
